name: Carpet Workflow Isolation Fix
notes: Carpet operations are isolated from Product Master and general-material inventory.
Carpet Customer Return completion now uses the item workflow instead of the parent Customer Return type.
Returned carpet rolls can complete directly into Carpet Inventory without Product Master validation.
Product Search and Existing Inventory Record are hidden during carpet workflows.
Underlayment and general materials remain on their own inventory workflow and only connect at the order level.
